# VONQ Hiring API (HAPI)

> Guides, scenarios, workflow maps, and exact HTTP contracts for HAPI integrations.

Clone `vonq/hapi-docs`, start with this index or `docs-manifest.jsonl`, then use `rg` to open only the files your task needs.

## Start here

- [Introduction](docs/01-introduction.md): What is HAPI, key features, getting started with credentials and first API call.
- [API Overview](docs/02-api-overview.md): Base URLs, environments, HTTP conventions, pagination, rate limits, error handling, localization, CORS, and caching.
- [Environments](docs/02b-environments.md): Production vs Sandbox-base URLs, separate provisioning, what sandbox does and does not do, and how to test campaign lifecycles without real deliveries.

## Recipes

- [Recipes-Introduction](docs/recipes/01-introduction.md): Implement a HAPI integration screen by screen. For each screen of a standard ATS ordering flow, the calls it makes, the data it keeps, and the tests that prove it works.
- [Recipe-Customer Accounts](docs/recipes/02-customer-accounts.md): Link each customer account of your ATS to a HAPI customer once, read its feature settings, and set up the one server-side HTTP client every other recipe uses.
- [Recipe-Job to Vacancy](docs/recipes/03-job-to-vacancy.md): Map an ATS job onto HAPI vacancy fields and taxonomy. Pickers for job title, location and targeting, what each ID is used for, the field rules, and Smartfill prefill.
- [Recipe-Channel Selection](docs/recipes/04-channel-selection.md): Wizard step 1. Search the marketplace with filters taken from the job, show what bundles contain, offer favorites and AI recommendations, and keep a cart that survives a reload.
- [Recipe-Job Board Connections](docs/recipes/05-job-board-connections.md): Let recruiters connect their own job board accounts as contracts, on a settings page or inside checkout, including OAuth, manual setup, groups and broken credentials.
- [Recipe-Posting Requirements Form](docs/recipes/06-posting-requirements-form.md): Wizard step 2. Build the per-channel form from facet definitions, load options on demand, apply display rules, prefill with Smartfill, and validate before checkout.
- [Recipe-Checkout and Order](docs/recipes/07-checkout-and-order.md): Wizard steps 3 and 4. Assemble the order from the job, cart and requirement answers, validate it, let the customer pay the way their account allows, and place it safely once.
- [Recipe-Campaign Tracking](docs/recipes/08-campaign-tracking.md): Wizard step 5 and the job's campaign tab. Show per-channel status, links and clicks, keep them current with webhooks and an incremental sync, and let recruiters edit or take channels offline.
- [Recipe-End-to-End Testing](docs/recipes/09-end-to-end-testing.md): Prove the integration before go-live. What Sandbox can and cannot test, how to run every recipe's scenarios as an automated suite, how to drive a campaign lifecycle, and what to switch for Production.

## Scenarios and workflows

- [Scenarios-Introduction](docs/guides/14-scenarios/01-introduction.md): End-to-end walkthroughs showing how to accomplish common tasks with the VONQ Hiring API.
- [Scenario-Setting Up a Contract](docs/guides/14-scenarios/contract-setup.md): End-to-end walkthrough-find a channel, check credentials, handle OAuth, create a contract, and verify it.
- [Scenario-Job Marketing Campaign](docs/guides/14-scenarios/job-marketing-ordering.md): End-to-end walkthrough-search for products, fill vacancy fields, validate, and place a Job Marketing campaign order.
- [Scenario-Job Post Campaign](docs/guides/14-scenarios/job-post-campaign.md): End-to-end walkthrough-find a channel, use a contract, collect posting requirements, validate, and order a Job Post campaign.
- [Scenario-Mixed Campaign](docs/guides/14-scenarios/mixed-campaign.md): Combining Job Marketing and Job Post products in a single campaign order.
- [Scenario-Screening](docs/guides/14-scenarios/screening.md): End-to-end walkthrough-create a screening job, collect candidate data, submit applications, receive AI-scored dossiers.
- [API workflow map](docs/extra/api-map.yaml): Call sequences, dependencies, and decision points.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Machine-Readable Resources](docs/13-machine-readable-resources.md): Selective discovery with the documentation manifest, OpenAPI schema, workflow map, glossary, and llms.txt.
- [Documentation manifest](docs-manifest.jsonl): Document metadata and OpenAPI operation index.
- [OpenAPI schema](schema/build/public.json): Exact paths, parameters, payloads, responses, and auth.
- [Glossary](docs/extra/glossary.yaml): HAPI terms, aliases, and disambiguation.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Selective retrieval commands and source authority.
